educationalGoal: The world around us is full of music. Living in modern society, we come in contact with music every day and often we do not pay any attention to what we are listening to. In this course, students will focus on listening to music intentionally. Students will learn music appreciation by exploring the following two areas. 1) Music we choose to listen to; 2) Music we are unintentionally exposed to. We will focus on music that is around us and learn how music can enrich our daily lives and society as a whole.
advice:
The following topics will be dealt with in this course.

1) Characteristics and features of music genres, songs, and composers.

2) How music is used in modern society and its impact.

3) The intersection of music and specialty areas.

Students will learn key concepts and terminology associated with each of these topics, listen to music examples, and have group discussions to further their understanding.

Assessment is based on active participation during class, completing assignments, and preparing a final presentation. (See below for details.)
requiredKnowledge:
It is important to be interested in listening to music. It is helpful, but not required, to listen to music (regardless of genre) on a daily basis. This will be helpful for constructive participation during class discussion and homework assignments.
It is required that students attend every class, submit assignments on time, and contribute positively to class discussions.

              The world around us is full of music. Living in modern society, we come in contact with music every day and often we do not pay any attention to what we are listening to. In this course, students will focus on listening to music intentionally. Students will learn music appreciation by exploring the following two areas. 1) Music we choose to listen to; 2) Music we are unintentionally exposed to. We will focus on music that is around us and learn how music can enrich our daily lives and society as a whole.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              The following topics will be dealt with in this course.

1) Characteristics and features of music genres, songs, and composers.

2) How music is used in modern society and its impact.

3) The intersection of music and specialty areas.

Students will learn key concepts and terminology associated with each of these topics, listen to music examples, and have group discussions to further their understanding.

Assessment is based on active participation during class, completing assignments, and preparing a final presentation. (See below for details.)

              教科書および参考書・リザーブドブック

              No required textbook.

              履修に必要な予備知識や技能

              It is important to be interested in listening to music. It is helpful, but not required, to listen to music (regardless of genre) on a daily basis. This will be helpful for constructive participation during class discussion and homework assignments.
It is required that students attend every class, submit assignments on time, and contribute positively to class discussions.
